subject: Ready for final MAP signoff & start-week alignment - BrightCart POC
messages:
From: Sarah Milton <sarah@brightcart.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP timing & signoff window for POC

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at BrightCart is excited to kick off the POC. We've reviewed the mutual action plan you shared in the call, and procurement wants an explicit go/no-go signoff timeline plus the exact dates we should expect to sign and the first production/start week. Our internal sponsor (VP Product) needs to see the final MAP + SOW and a proposed execution week to align the integration resources.

Can you confirm:
- When can we expect the final MAP and SOW?
- What is the target signature window (DocuSign)?
- Proposed start/boarding week if we sign?

Procurement will also send a PO stub as soon as we confirm the signature window.

Sarah
Sarah Milton
Head of Integrations, BrightCart
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-05T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP timing & signoff window for POC

Team — forwarding Sarah's note. Short ask: we need legal and solutions to lock the MAP + SOW and give a hard signature window for BrightCart (they want to align internal resources). Target timeline they'd like is late Jan signature / early Feb start-week.

Quick tasks: 
- Karthik: can you confirm any redlines that would push signature beyond Jan 25?
- Camila: update the MAP to include the onboarding checklist and day-1 success criteria (they asked for explicit start-week deliverables).
- Laura: pricing/discount note — what flexibility do we have on month-1 credits if they need a one-week pilot?

Can we get a consolidated response by EOD Jan 7? If legal clears earlier we can send the DocuSign link to them.

Thanks — Michael
Michael Grant
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-07T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP timing & signoff window for POC

Michael / Camila — reviewed the current SOW and MAP drafts. High level: clean, but there are two items I'd like clarified before we hand to BrightCart for signature:

1) Data retention clause: BrightCart asked for 90-day logs in the eval — our default is 30 days for hosted API. If we want to give 90 days for the POC, note it as a scoped exception in the MAP (temp exception).
2) SLA language for dedicated pilot nodes: suggested phrasing "target latency SLAs consistent with platform profile; no production SLA applied during POC" — keeps expectations clear.

If we accept the 90-day retention for the POC only, I don't think anything else will block a late-Jan signature. Otherwise, a negotiation on retention will push things by ~1 week.

Karthik
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Milton <sarah@brightcart.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-09T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final MAP + SOW attached — proposed signature window 2027-01-25 to 2027-01-27

Hi Sarah — attaching the updated MAP (v3) and SOW. Changes and notes: 
- MAP_v3 includes the onboarding checklist and Day 1 success criteria per Camila.
- SOW includes a POC-scoped data-retention exception: 90 days for logs during the POC only (per Karthik).
- Pricing: Laura approved a one-week pilot credit (applied as a one-time invoice credit in month 1).

Proposed signature window: Jan 25–27 (DocuSign envelope will be live during that period). Proposed start/boarding week: Feb 1 (week of Feb 1) — this gives BrightCart a handover week of Jan 28–29 for preflight and runbook review.

If that window works for you, I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and share the link. If procurement needs a PO before signature, please attach the PO here and procurement@brightcart.com can be cc'd on the envelope.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: BrightCart_MAP_v3.pdf (application/pdf), BrightCart_SOW_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Sarah Milton <sarah@brightcart.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: 2027-01-11T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Final MAP + SOW attached — proposed signature window 2027-01-25 to 2027-01-27

Michael — thanks for the fast turnaround and for including the retention exception; that addresses our security team's immediate concern. Procurement is attaching the PO stub here (see attachment). The Jan 25–27 signature window works for our legal ops team.

One ask: can we move the start/boarding week up by one week to Jan 25 (pilot kick-off Jan 25, full onboarding week Jan 25–29) if signatures complete on Jan 25? We have an internal deadline to validate a checkout flow by mid-Feb and an earlier start helps. If you can commit to having a tech-intro call on Jan 26 and a short preflight on Jan 27, we can compress the schedule.

Please include the DocuSign link once you send the envelope; procurement will countersign same day.

Sarah Milton
Head of Integrations, BrightCart
Attachment: BrightCart_PO_stub.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-13T16:47:00-08:00
Subject: Final internal: Ready to send DocuSign (target sign 2027-01-25) and start-week update

Team — bright update: BrightCart accepted the retention exception and wants to move the start-week earlier if we can get signatures on Jan 25. They attached a PO stub. Actions before I send envelope on Jan 24 (so it goes live 25th):
- Camila: confirm the preflight checklist is ready for a Jan 26 tech-intro and Jan 27 preflight session. Add the compressed-week notes to the MAP and update Day 0/Day 1 deliverables.
- Laura: confirm the one-week pilot credit language and the billing contact for the invoice so procurement can process the PO the day signatures complete.
- Karthik: legal sign-off to include procurement@brightcart.com on the DocuSign envelope and confirm no additional redlines.

I'll queue the envelope on Jan 24 (send EOD) and share the DocuSign link. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/78921 — I'll add the PO and the updated MAP.

Thanks — Michael
Michael Grant
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
